purpose: Evaluate tool-role operating envelopes on real economic series backgrounds with controlled permanent mean-shift injections and independent synthetic null traces. This is not a forecast-accuracy test.

C1.selection: deterministic stratified sample from the 147 verified G1 composite-failure GEM identities; strata include G1 failure class, observation-count band, and pre-break AR dependence band.

C2.selection: deterministic stratified sample of 20 from the frozen 50-series C2 sample; source/cohort, observation-count band, domain, and pre-break AR dependence band are represented.

C3.selection: known-break external validation using only verified event/series matches and point-in-time source vintages.
C3.not_executed_reason: Current P2.2 snapshots do not prove that each historical observation vintage was available at its historical decision time. Retrospective matches alone are not online ground truth.

pilot_cohorts.execution_rule: Run 20 series for each verified cohort. C3 is omitted until its source-vintage requirement is met; no substitute cohort may be silently added.

injection_design.break_index_rule: floor(position_fraction * observation_count), zero-based; shift applies from break_index through the end.
injection_design.sigma_reference: 1.4826 * MAD of residuals from the selected AR(p) model fitted on the complete pre-break prefix.
injection_design.short_prebreak_rule: NOT_ELIGIBLE for that injection position; record reason and preserve the case in coverage accounting. Do not treat ineligibility as a detector miss.

ar_null_and_calibration.order_selection: minimum AIC on the complete pre-break prefix
ar_null_and_calibration.fit_scope: complete pre-break prefix only; never use observations after the injected break to fit the null model
ar_null_and_calibration.stability_gate: Reject a fitted model with non-finite parameters, insufficient residual degrees of freedom, singular fit, or any autoregressive root not strictly outside the unit circle.
ar_null_and_calibration.unstable_or_short_fit: NOT_ELIGIBLE with a machine-readable reason; no fallback to AR(1) without recording a new protocol version.
ar_null_and_calibration.null_seed_streams: SHA-256-derived independent streams by protocol version, series_id, position, model order, phase, and replicate index; development and holdout seeds must not overlap.
ar_null_and_calibration.synthetic_null_fpr_definition: P0(>=1 false alarm within the exact original series horizon) over independent parametric AR(p) null traces.
ar_null_and_calibration.threshold_selection: Select a per-series/per-position threshold on development traces only. Choose the smallest threshold whose one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for development P0 is <= 0.10. Freeze it before holdout and injection evaluation.
ar_null_and_calibration.holdout_rule: Evaluate the frozen threshold on the independent 1000-trace holdout set. Do not retune on holdout.
ar_null_and_calibration.confidence_interval: Wilson score interval, 95%, computed from valid independent null replicates.

arl0_reporting.rule: Report empirical ARL0 or a right-censored restricted mean run length only when the simulation horizon supports the target. Mark larger-than-horizon targets NOT_ESTIMABLE; never infer P0 from 1/ARL0.

additional_null.purpose: negative-control diagnostic: preserves the marginal distribution while destroying temporal order
additional_null.acceptance_role: diagnostic only; not a substitute for the parametric AR(p) null

original_alarm_burden.definition: number and timing of alarms on the unmodified original series under the frozen per-series threshold
original_alarm_burden.interpretation: descriptive diagnostic only; never label as false-positive rate without independently adjudicated event truth

alarm_burden_ratio.definition: original_series_alarm_count divided by the expected alarm count under matched synthetic null traces; denominator zero is reported as UNDEFINED, not infinity
alarm_burden_ratio.interpretation: diagnostic misspecification flag only; not an automatic detector failure

measurements.recall: A case is detected only by a direction-correct alarm at or after the injected break. A pre-onset alarm is recorded separately and cannot count as a true positive.
measurements.false_negative: No direction-correct detection by the end of the series is a false negative; it remains in the recall denominator.
measurements.delay: detection_index - true_break_index for matched detections only; report median and P90, with missed cases reported separately.
measurements.wrong_direction_rate: wrong-sign alarms after the true break divided by eligible injected cases.
measurements.coverage: Report eligible and NOT_ELIGIBLE counts by cohort, position, magnitude, direction, and tool. Never remove ineligible cases from the denominator without publishing the coverage denominator.
measurements.series_variability: Report per-series recall distribution, coefficient of variation, and source/domain/length/autocorrelation strata; aggregate mean alone is insufficient.
measurements.minimum_detectable_effect: Smallest tested magnitude whose series-clustered 95% lower confidence bound for recall reaches 0.80. If no tested magnitude reaches it, report >2 sigma.

cost_weighted_diagnostic.role: secondary comparison only; cannot override any mandatory gate

FOCuS.reset_policy: After a confirmed hit, reset the functional-pruning state and re-arm only after a new 40-observation regime calibration window. Record the re-arm interval explicitly; changes occurring inside it are not silently discarded.
FOCuS.threshold: per-series/per-position threshold selected by the development AR(p) null procedure

Bartlett_LRV.comparison: FOCuS_RESET_ARL_PILOT with MAD scale versus the same detector with Bartlett-LRV scale; same AR(p) null traces, same P0 target, and independently calibrated thresholds.

primary_success.calibration_error_improvement: absolute holdout P0 calibration error is reduced by >= 30% relative to MAD
primary_success.recall_noninferiority: recall loss at 1sigma is no more than 0.10
primary_success.clarification: Do not claim a 20% FPR reduction after forcing both variants to the same calibrated P0 target.

BOCPD.required_output: full posterior P(run_length_t | observations_through_t) for every evaluated prefix

series_level_test.effect_size: standardized paired difference in per-series variance of log(run_length + 1)
series_level_test.note: Do not apply Mann-Whitney U or KS to dependent time points as if they were independent.

incremental_value_rule.fusion: A FOCuS candidate is confirmed only if BOCPD short-run posterior mass >= 0.35 within +/-3 observations of the FOCuS detection time; this is a predeclared measurement rule, not a standalone BOCPD binary role.
incremental_value_rule.success: Either recall improves by >= 5 percentage points with no synthetic-null FPR worsening, or synthetic-null FPR improves by >= 5 percentage points with recall loss <= 0.10.

BOCPD.forecast_value: Not tested in this Pilot; requires separate Rolling-Origin out-of-sample forecast evaluation in Engine 2.

R-FPOP.matching: One-to-one matching between the single injected break and at most one estimated breakpoint; every extra breakpoint is a false breakpoint.
R-FPOP.null_control: Compare false breakpoints with a randomized segmentation null on the same series; freeze the robust segmentation penalty before holdout.

primary_success.interpretation: Retrospective segmentation only; no online-warning claim.

statistical_decision_rules.confidence_intervals: Cluster bootstrap by series, 2000 resamples, for recall, delay, and per-series variability. Null FPR uses Wilson intervals over independent AR(p) replicates, then series-level aggregation.
statistical_decision_rules.pass: The lower 95% confidence bound is at or above a minimum-performance threshold, or the upper 95% bound is at or below a maximum-risk threshold, as specified for that tool.
statistical_decision_rules.fail: The corresponding confidence interval lies wholly on the failing side of its threshold.
statistical_decision_rules.inconclusive: A confidence interval crosses the acceptance threshold, fewer than 80% of planned series/conditions are eligible, or fewer than 950 of 1000 null replicates are valid.

phase_decision.VALIDATED: At least one tool passes its assigned role on both C1 and C2, all mandatory causal and data-integrity gates pass, and the declared operating envelope is restricted to tested cohorts/conditions. C3 status must remain explicitly visible.
phase_decision.LOCKED_REJECTED: All candidate tools fail their assigned roles on C1 and C2 with adequate eligible coverage and confidence intervals entirely on the failing side.
phase_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is underpowered, coverage is insufficient, or any required confidence interval crosses the decision boundary.

execution.matrix: one job per series; each job owns the original baseline and all 18 injected conditions for that series
execution.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 each per-series JSON before upload; aggregate only exact expected series IDs and verify all file hashes.
execution.replay: Every series result must include one deterministic replay command plus source, model, threshold, and seed identities.
execution.pilot_start_gate: Do not dispatch until C1 IDs, C2 50-series frame and 20-series pilot sample, protocol SHA, schema tests, and injection-code gates are committed and green. C3 may remain pending only with explicit scope limitation.
